findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext discards all recorded logs
findings.body: FromContext returns a brand-new TestLogger instead of the receiver or an instance sharing the receiver's recording state. LoggerMiddleware now logs through m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), so a test that injects a TestLogger into LoggerMiddleware will observe zero InfoLogs on the injected logger because the log call is recorded on an orphaned instance. This makes the new logging path untestable with the provided fake; FromContext should return the receiver (or share its Logs state).

findings.title: LoggerMiddleware silently loses identifying fields when used without ContextualLoggerMiddleware
findings.body: logRequest no longer receives the PluginContext or endpoint and no longer adds pluginId, endpoint, dsName, dsUID, uname, or traceID itself; it now relies entirely on ContextualLoggerMiddleware having already enriched ctx. NewLoggerMiddleware's signature and contract give no indication of that new ordering dependency, so any existing or future decorator chain, test, or direct use of LoggerMiddleware without ContextualLoggerMiddleware immediately before it will emit 'Plugin Request Completed' logs missing the plugin/endpoint/datasource/user fields that LoggerMiddleware previously guaranteed on its own. The main CreateMiddlewares ordering happens to satisfy the dependency, but the middleware's standalone behavior is silently degraded.

findings.title: No test covers the new contextual-logger propagation that logging now depends on
findings.body: The PR moves endpoint/pluginId/dsName/dsUID/uname enrichment into the new ContextualLoggerMiddleware and makes LoggerMiddleware consume it via FromContext, but adds no test for NewContextualLoggerMiddleware or for the ContextualLoggerMiddleware -> LoggerMiddleware composition, and the renamed metrics test only asserts Prometheus metrics. A regression in instrumentContext, in the middleware ordering in CreateMiddlewares, or in Logger.FromContext would silently drop those fields from 'Plugin Request Completed' and downstream plugin logs with no failing test. Add a decorator-level test asserting the next client receives the enriched context and that the completed-request log carries the expected fields.
